summary: Registration thunk: passes the address of the callback at 0x004C3000 into BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E) and returns the conversion result. The callback pointer is read (R) from the global at 0x004C3000.

operations.description: Calls BooleanToIntConversion at 0x00587B3E with a single argument: the address of the function at 0x004C3000 (read from that global), cast to int.
Returns the int value produced by BooleanToIntConversion.
